text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: The orbitofrontal cortex and its role in the

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: assignment of behavioural significance.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: The

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: orbitofrontal cortex (OFC) plays a crucial role in

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: evaluating the behavioural significance of salient

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: environmental stimuli. This region is involved in

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: processing the value of reinforcers and the

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: hedonicity of stimuli, but it also responds to

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: affectively neutral stimuli that require an

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: immediate adjustment of behavior. The OFC is

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: responsive to different types of behaviourally

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: significant events, regardless of their affective

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: valence or the associated response demands. This

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: suggests that the OFC is not limited to processing

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: reward and positive incentive value, but is more

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: generally involved in evaluating the behavioural

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: relevance of salient stimuli. As a result, the OFC is

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: thought to be involved in prioritizing attentional

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: selection and behavioural control.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Generated description (complete)

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: [NETWORK] Orbitofrontal-Affective Network

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: The

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: orbitofrontal-affective network includes ventromedial, lateral

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: and medial orbitofrontalis; anterior cingulate cortex; superior

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: frontal gyrus; dorsomedian temporal gyri. It supports

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: evaluation of value in reward-related contexts as well as

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: affective meaning associated with decisions made within it.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: [REGION] Orbitofrontal Cortex

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: The orbitofrontal cortex is a

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: region of fovea and frontal lobe. It lies on the ventral surface

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: above the caudate nucleus, medial prefrontal cortex,

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: parieto-occipital junction, lateral occipital cortex, superior

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: temporal sulcus, inferior frontal gyrus, and insula. Its

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: involvement in value judgment and affective meaning makes it

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: an important component for evaluating sensory input.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: [FUNCTION] Orbitofrontal Perception Map

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Orbital

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: perception map commonly involves ventral orbitofacial cortex,

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: insula, amygdala and hippocampus. These regions support

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: evaluation of taste, smell, value or flavor in food-related

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: contexts. Their anatomy supports integration with affective

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: processing for sensory judgment.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Why ruminators won't stop: the structural and

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: resting state correlates of rumination and its

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: relation to depression.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Rumination, a cognitive

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: process characterized by repetitive and negative

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: thinking, is associated with structural and functional

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: abnormalities in the brain. Specifically, rumination is

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: linked to reduced grey matter volume in key

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: regions, including the bilateral inferior frontal gyrus,

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: left anterior cingulate cortex, and bilateral mid

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: cingulate cortex. These brain areas are involved in

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: cognitive control processes, such as inhibition and

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: thought suppression. Additionally, resting state

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: activity in these regions, particularly the anterior

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: cingulate cortex and right inferior frontal gyrus, is

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: also reduced in individuals who ruminate. These

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: findings suggest that rumination may be a predictor

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: of major depression, not only due to its behavioral

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: characteristics but also due to its association with

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: neuroanatomical abnormalities similar to those

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: found in depression.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Generated description (complete)

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: [NETWORK] Salience Network

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: The salience network

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: includes the medial prefrontal cortex, posterior cingulate

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: gyrus, amygdala, and dorsal anterior insula. It is generally

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: associated with detecting meaningful or emotionally

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: significant information in dynamic environments. The

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: network may also support attribution of meaning to events

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: as they occur. Its connections are thought to help organize

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: internally coordinated responses toward important stimuli.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: [REGION] Ventromedial Prefrontal Cortex

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Broadly tied

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: to value-based cognition, this region is often engaged when

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: individuals reflect on their own or others' decisions. It is

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: associated with self-relevance and the appraisal of personal

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: outcomes. Its description tends to focus on integrating

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: affective meaning alongside cognitive processing.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: [FUNCTION] Value-Based Judgment

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Value-based

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: judgment is commonly associated with the ventromedial

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: prefrontal cortex, anterior cingulate cortex, orbitofrontal and

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: ventral striatal regions. These connections support

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: evaluation of subjective value in real-world situations. The

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: activity across these areas helps direct attention toward

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: potential outcomes or preferences.
